common.static_state: the one positive-frequency static ground G_plus from the quantum v1 contract

common_total_rules.arithmetic: every inexact operation uses a 512-bit outward ball in its lane; exact integers, reduced rationals and dyadics remain exact
common_total_rules.projection: project only at the role-specific ordinal stated below; nearest n*2^-448 with ties-to-even, exactly once, no retry
common_total_rules.ordering: ascending role ordinal, then the explicit row-major or graded-lexicographic packing; every tie chooses the least canonical ordinal
common_total_rules.strictness: every upper width, tail, defect, contraction, residual and exhaustion bound is strict; equality touches and fails
common_total_rules.no_fallback: a failed predicate or exhausted fixed counter persists the partial role record and terminates the lane without precision escalation, subdivision, selector change or alternate method
common_total_rules.candidate_neutrality: all selectors in this contract are fixed from exact formulas and manufactured-fixture considerations; none consumes a selected background or positive continuation sample
common_total_rules.error_rule: for every reported scalar entry persist all eight nonnegative outward component widths in the listed order; an unused component is exact zero; each component must be strictly below 2^-132 and their exact rational sum must be strictly below 2^-120
common_total_rules.accumulation: sum contributions lexicographically by component, role-output ordinal and quadrature ordinal; pairwise or parallel reduction is forbidden
common_total_rules.threshold_rule: lambda=1 belongs to the complete Stieltjes measure and is never removed; every energy panel crossing its compactified coordinate is split at the exact threshold before quadrature
common_total_rules.root_rule: the primary and independent future candidate roots must be absent before and throughout definition and fixture work

shared_exact_coordinates.radial_compactification: y=r/(1+r) on the frozen 256-cell origin/bulk/infinity cover
shared_exact_coordinates.energy_threshold: e_threshold=(1-alpha_min^2)/(2-alpha_min^2), represented as an outward ball derived from the certified alpha_min^2 ball
shared_exact_coordinates.multiindex_order: graded lexicographic (total degree,t,r,theta,phi), with the four-index tuple compared left to right within a degree

primary_cpp_arb_total_algorithm.lineage: C++20 with Arb/FLINT/GMP/MPFR only in the already bound offline primary image

P08_radial_resolvent.basis_and_nodes: on each frozen radial cell use degree-24 first-kind Chebyshev coefficients and the 25 CGL nodes tau_j=cos(pi*j/24); physical wire order is ascending y, with the origin or infinity end first in its propagation direction
P08_radial_resolvent.system: rewrite each radial equation as the exact two-component first-order system fixed by the quantum v1 operator; solve 50 unknown coefficient entries using two incoming endpoint rows and both ODE components at the remaining 24 nodes
P08_radial_resolvent.interfaces: regular solutions propagate origin-to-infinity and Weyl solutions infinity-to-origin; the outgoing ball at one cell is the incoming ball of the next and no interface averaging occurs
P08_radial_resolvent.factorization: deterministic complete-pivot Arb LU using largest certified lower absolute pivot and least row-major ordinal tie; a best pivot containing zero fails
P08_radial_resolvent.defect: perform exactly eight defect-correction sweeps; exact-zero correction is a no-op, otherwise the directed max residual must strictly decrease; after sweep eight certify the degree-48 Bernstein enclosure of the integral defect and a strict contraction constant below one
P08_radial_resolvent.endpoints: use only the frozen origin Frobenius and q=1/r infinity recurrences and their pre-existing remainder covers
P08_radial_resolvent.projection: after the eighth sweep and before Wronskian assembly, project every canonical coefficient once

P09_angular_subtraction.coefficient_recurrence: for each consumed derivative channel insert R=sum_(j=0)^20 a_j*nu^(-1-2*j), nu=ell+1/2, into the exact Liouville-normal diagonal-resolvent identity -2*R*R''+(R')^2+4*(V-z)*R^2=1 and solve a_j in ascending j and graded-lexicographic derivative order with the positive leading root
P09_angular_subtraction.packing: channel ordinal, derivative multiindex, coefficient j, radial cell, polynomial coefficient
P09_angular_subtraction.finite_sum: sum ell=0 through 255 in ascending ell and m-degeneracy order after subtracting the order-20 parametrix
P09_angular_subtraction.tail: sum each explicit inverse power using Arb Hurwitz zeta at q=511/2; enclose the first omitted recurrence coefficient by eight fixed majorant iterations and multiply by the geometric majorant 1/(1-rho), requiring rho<1
P09_angular_subtraction.threshold: apply the same Stieltjes threshold classifier used in P11; undecided resonance or accumulation enclosure fails before tail acceptance

P10_negative_axis.Gauss_Legendre: construct the 32 roots of P_32 once: scan the exact rational mesh j/4096 on [-1,1], isolate the 32 sign changes using the exact Legendre recurrence, perform 600 exact rational bisections, then 16 outward interval-Newton steps; weights are 2/((1-u^2)*(P_32'(u))^2); sort by increasing u
P10_negative_axis.validation: on every panel form a degree-63 interval Taylor model about its midpoint; integrate its polynomial exactly, compare with the mapped 32-node rule, and add the derivative-64 Taylor remainder in canonical order
P10_negative_axis.tail: apply the frozen order-20 resolvent/heat expansion from kappa_star to infinity; eight majorant iterations must certify ratio below one and the whole tail strictly below 2^-132

P11_physical_measure_and_smearing.panels: e in [0,4095/4096], base panel i=[4095*i/8388608,4095*(i+1)/8388608] for i=0..2047; split a base panel at the outward e_threshold ball into left/threshold/right tagged subpanels without changing the base-panel count
P11_physical_measure_and_smearing.quadrature: reuse the certified 32-point primary Gauss-Legendre rule and degree-63 Taylor validation on every tagged subpanel
P11_physical_measure_and_smearing.Stieltjes_pairing: for every compact-time multiplier F use I_epsilon(F)=pi^-1*integral F(lambda)*Im<m,(K-lambda-i*epsilon)^-1 m> d lambda over the complete measure; atoms and threshold accumulation remain inside this pairing
P11_physical_measure_and_smearing.Richardson: for the nine inherited epsilon values solve the exact 9x9 Vandermonde system sum_j w_j*epsilon_j^k=delta_(k,0) for k=0..8 and accumulate sum_j w_j*I_epsilon_j
P11_physical_measure_and_smearing.remainder: use the Poisson-semigroup identity and bound the ninth-order remainder by (sum_j |w_j|*epsilon_j^9)/9! times the certified total spectral mass of the smeared test vector times the certified L1 norm of |omega|^9 times the Fourier transform of F; strict closure below 2^-132 is required and no pointwise density assumption is made
P11_physical_measure_and_smearing.energy_tail: from e_star to one apply the order-20 heat/resolvent asymptotic with positivity and eight majorant iterations
P11_physical_measure_and_smearing.smearing: map each compact time and radial bump support affinely to [-1,1], use 128 equal panels per coordinate and the same GL32 rule; compute each Z_p and numerator separately, require lower(Z_p)>0, divide once and verify normalization contains one

P12_Hadamard_RSET.basis: covariant normal-coordinate monomials packed in the shared graded-lexicographic order; retain U and V through total order 20 and every coincidence jet through total derivative order four
P12_Hadamard_RSET.transport_equations: write P=Box-1, U=Delta^(1/2), V=sum_(n>=0) V_n*sigma^n. Fix [U]=1. In D=4 solve 2*V_0+2*sigma^;a*nabla_a V_0-2*V_0*Delta^(-1/2)*sigma^;a*nabla_a Delta^(1/2)+P*U=0 and, for n>=0, (n+1)*(2*n+4)*V_(n+1)+2*(n+1)*sigma^;a*nabla_a V_(n+1)-2*(n+1)*V_(n+1)*Delta^(-1/2)*sigma^;a*nabla_a Delta^(1/2)+P*V_n=0, in the exact sign and Feynman-parametrix convention of quantum v1
P12_Hadamard_RSET.transport_solve: substitute the packed series into those equations and solve triangular coefficient rows in increasing total degree, equation ordinal and component ordinal using complete-pivot Arb LU for each non-scalar row
P12_Hadamard_RSET.state_remainder: W_DF is not generated by local geometric transport: compute its packed coincidence jets by subtracting the projected U and V parametrix from the P10/P11 static-ground Feynman two-point product in the quantum-v1 bracket convention
P12_Hadamard_RSET.correction: perform exactly eight directed residual-correction sweeps; exact-zero rows are no-ops and every nonzero correction must strictly reduce the row residual
P12_Hadamard_RSET.projection: project every coefficient once after sweep eight, then recompute U, V, W_DF, v1, RSET and conservation residuals from projected bytes
P12_Hadamard_RSET.remainder: a degree-21 covariant Taylor majorant and eight ratio iterations must enclose every omitted term and every derivative consumed by conservation below its assigned 2^-132 component

P13_noise_Gram.vector_packing: vector ordinal a=4*p+I, then angular ordinal, negative-axis or energy quadrature ordinal, radial cell, local coefficient and two-particle symmetrized pair ordinal; all omitted sectors are represented by one certified Hilbert-norm tail ball
P13_noise_Gram.normalization_phase: normalize by a strictly positive enclosed norm; choose the phase so the first canonical coefficient whose ball excludes zero has positive real midpoint and zero imaginary midpoint; no such coefficient fails
P13_noise_Gram.factor: form the direct interval Gram matrix, then perform unpivoted lower Cholesky in ordinal order; a pivot containing zero fails unless the entire residual row is exact zero, in which case the row of L is exact zero; apply exactly two lower-triangular linearized residual-correction sweeps and require strict row-residual decrease on each nonzero sweep
P13_noise_Gram.verification: persist 32896 lower-triangular entries, reconstruct L*L^T, and require the lexicographic row-sum residual plus all vector-tail contributions strictly below 2^-132; no eigenvalue clipping occurs
P13_noise_Gram.projection: project the finite vector coefficients once before direct Gram formation and project L once after factorization
P13_noise_Gram.smearing: reuse P11's 128-panel GL32 time/radial bump construction for every p and channel

native_transcendentals.pi: Machin pi=16*atan(1/5)-4*atan(1/239), each atan evaluated by exactly 160 alternating-series terms plus the first-omitted-term enclosure
native_transcendentals.elementary: sinh, cosh and exp on absolute arguments at most 12 use degree-256 Taylor series plus the Lagrange remainder; tanh is sinh/cosh with a strictly positive denominator
native_transcendentals.large_negative_exp: for bump exponents below -12, repeatedly halve until magnitude at most 12, evaluate exp, and square outward at most 4096 times; if the exponent upper bound is below -1024, return [0,2^-1024] using the certified pi-independent exponential monotonicity bound
native_transcendentals.complex_division: (a+ib)/(c+id) uses denominator c^2+d^2 and fails unless its lower endpoint is strictly positive

R08_radial_resolvent.Picard_seed: the seed radius is the least power of two not below twice the outward local defect norm, capped at 2^-16; a larger requirement fails
R08_radial_resolvent.Picard: apply exactly 12 interval Picard images; each must be a strict interior subset of the previous enclosure after the first image and the final Lipschitz upper bound must be below one

R08_radial_resolvent.projection: project each cell's outgoing Taylor coefficients once after its twelfth Picard image

R09_angular_subtraction.packing: channel ordinal, derivative multiindex, heat coefficient, radial cell, Bernstein coefficient
R09_angular_subtraction.finite_sum: sum ell=0 through 287 in ascending ell and m-degeneracy order after subtracting order 22
R09_angular_subtraction.tail: sum inverse powers from nu=577/2 using a fixed 64-term Euler-Maclaurin formula with Bernoulli numbers generated by the exact Akiyama-Tanigawa recurrence; 12 majorant iterations must certify the first omitted derivative remainder and ratio below one
